sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: At Sandy's Nail Nest, we believe every woman deserves to feel confident and beautiful. Located in the heart of Karu, Nasarawa State, we've built a reputation as the go-to destination for exceptional nail care and creative designs. Our passion is bringing your nail art dreams to life with precision, hygiene, and artistic flair. Whether you're preparing for a special occasion or simply treating yourself to some self-care, our skilled team ensures every visit leaves you feeling pampered and polished.
sections.imagePrompt: Warm inviting Nigerian nail salon atmosphere, close-up of professional nail technician carefully applying nail polish to a client's hand, natural lighting through windows, cozy interior with plants and beauty products display, authentic African beauty care setting, photorealistic, friendly welcoming environment

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Classic Manicure & Pedicure: Treat your hands and feet to our signature spa treatment with nail shaping, cuticle care, exfoliation, massage, and polish. Perfect for maintaining healthy, beautiful nails.

Gel & Acrylic Nails: Long-lasting, durable nail enhancements that keep you looking fabulous for weeks. Choose from a variety of styles, lengths, and finishes.

Custom Nail Art: Express your personality with our bespoke nail art designs. From elegant French tips to bold patterns, 3D embellishments, and seasonal themes - we bring your vision to life.

Nail Extensions: Add length and strength to your natural nails with our professional extension services using premium materials.

Bridal & Special Occasion Nails: Make your special day even more memorable with our luxurious bridal nail packages. We create stunning designs that complement your style and theme.

Nail Care & Treatment: Restore and strengthen damaged nails with our specialized treatment services including nail repair, strengthening treatments, and cuticle therapy.

sections.name: Visit Us Today
sections.copy:
